update_md5_fa4c5062d022b9883974b48523a1f.name: readme_mcp_transports_note
update_md5_fa4c5062d022b9883974b48523a1f.find_text: - **stdio**: Run MCP server as a subprocess (most common) - **http**: Connect to HTTP-based MCP server - **sse**: Connect via Server-Sent Events
update_md5_fa4c5062d022b9883974b48523a1f.semantics: Add note about unsupported streamable_http transport.
update_md5_fa4c5062d022b9883974b48523a1f.content_md5_fa4c5062d022b9883974b48523a1:
- **stdio**: Run MCP server as a subprocess (most common) - **http**: Connect to HTTP-based MCP server - **sse**: Connect via Server-Sent Events
Note: `streamable_http` transport is not supported by Grok CLI.
